notes.title: Build 1.1.5 Release Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 1.1.5 is here, bringing lots of improvements in general, [b]crossplay fixes[/b], performance improvements & [b]bug fixes![/b][/p][p][/p][h1]📜Patch Notes 1.1.5[/h1][p][/p][h3][b]🔀 Cross-play[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We've fixed an issue where cross-play didn't work properly. There is still an issue when a Quest player hosts a game with a Steam player. The workaround is for the Steam user to host the game. We are still working on a fix for this bug, it should come shortly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]💰 Cash Register Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Added a maximum capacity to the register:[/b] 200 in single player and 400 in multiplayer co-op. Once the register is full, players must hide excess money in furniture they own.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🟢 Optimizations[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Optimized the State Authority system.[/b] This change should not affect gameplay directly, but improves overall framerate. It also helps reduce battery drain during large multiplayer sessions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🍾 Crafting and Resources[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]spawn rate was not normalized across different bag types[/b] (grain, cacao, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some [b]completed crafts in the brewery supplier showed no liquid[/b] in the end product.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]still could sometimes leak water from the cap[/b] even when not connected to its base.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where trying to write or draw at dusk did not display the “[b]Cannot craft[/b]” notification.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where forced releases from the player’s hand did not apply to connected objects [i](e.g., bottle and cork).[/i] Now they do.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added a VFX to the sewing needle[/b], which now shows a thread when stitching items together.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🏠 Furniture and Placement[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]furniture drawers could sometimes break[/b] when touched by the other player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues affecting the rolltop desk where its “[b]open/closed[/b]” state did not sync properly in co-op, creating gameplay desyncs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the rolltop desk where [b]hidden items sometimes failed to register[/b], causing players to be unjustly caught by police.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some [b]furniture sizes were not properly considered[/b] when placing them in the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, in multiplayer, the [b]oven displayed wood burning VFX indefinitely.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where posters were clipping through walls in level 3.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]🖨️ Serigraph and Typewriter[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]serigraph did not allow crafting Loto cards.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]2 papers could be placed in the typewriter, breaking it.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where police searches could break both the typewriter and serigraph functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where typewriter paper could despawn in co-op play.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, in co-op, the other player sometimes didn’t see the paper in the typewriter or the serigraph.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]grabbing the typewriter distorted the player’s hand.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where using the serigraph as the second player could [b]sometimes produce the wrong item.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]👕 Customization and Equippables[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed issues with certain equippable items in the Customization area of the hideout.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where plucked clothes could cause floating items to appear in the far corner of the Hideout.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]▶️ Gameplay and Objects[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]“Starting Money[/b]” perk did not provide usable money.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where objects thrown very far away [b]did not respawn.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, in multiplayer lobbies, Bobby sometimes did not respawn when thrown away in the Hideout. [i]Why would you throw him away anyway?[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues affecting various fade-to-black transitions in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the journal wouldn't update for player 1 when player 2 had unlocked something in the hideout.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player's hand could become unusable after destroying an object or interacting with immovable objects[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]💵 DLC Purchases[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Changed how DLC purchases are processed: [b]the game now uses the DLC system instead of Steam microtransactions.[/b] Purchases made through the microtransactions process may have caused issues. With this update, refunds will be issued to affected accounts, meaning you [i]may[/i] need to repurchase the DLC.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][u][b]Don't forget to check out our Socials and have a chat with other Eggs![/b][/u][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/prisonboss" style="button"]Discord[/url] [url="https://x.com/Prison_Boss_" style="button"]Twitter[/url] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/trebuchetvr.bsky.social" style="button"]BlueSky[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@prisonboss_" style="button"]TikTok[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/trebuchetvr" style="button"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2973830/Prison_Boss_Prohibition/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Build 1.1.4 Release Notes
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Patch 1.1.4 has arrived, and here are the release notes![/p][p][/p][h2]📜Patch Notes 1.1.4 [/h2][list][*][p][b]Multiplayer:[/b] When players purchase 30 items [i](15 per player)[/i] and pull the register at the same time, the game now correctly charges only for the items actually delivered, respecting the purchase limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where the [b]cash register drawer could become unusable[/b] for the rest of the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multiplayer:[/b] If the second player (client) takes the barrel with the beer mixture prepared by the first player (host) and fills bottles, they now fill correctly with the mixture instead of water.[/p][/*][*][p]Placing two sheets of paper into the typewriter at the same time [b]no longer breaks it.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where c[b]ustomers could get stuck at the counter[/b] until the player pulled the clock’s lever.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Menu interactions now require holding the button[/b] to confirm selections in dropdown panels.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b][u]Don't forget to check out our Socials and have a chat with other Eggs![/u][/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/prisonboss" style="button"]Discord[/url] [url="https://x.com/Prison_Boss_" style="button"]Twitter[/url] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/trebuchetvr.bsky.social" style="button"]BlueSky[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@prisonboss_" style="button"]TikTok[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/trebuchetvr" style="button"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2973830/Prison_Boss_Prohibition/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Custom Game Length, Leaderboards & More!
notes.content:
[h1]🥚Prison Boss: Prohibition – Patch Notes 1.1.3[/h1][p][/p][p]Hello you beautiful Eggs! 

We are back once more with a lengthy update this time, which includes [b]custom game length, leaderboards, a synced cash register, and more![/b] There's something for everyone, so if you're ready, let's take a look at the patch notes![/p][p][/p][h2]🆕[u]New Features[/u][/h2][p][/p][h3] 🕒Custom Game Length[/h3][p]Players can now choose between three different run lengths when starting a new game: [/p][list][*][p][b]Short[/b] (9 days)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Normal[/b] (12 days)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ludicrous[/b] (30 days)… for the overachieving crime tycoon in you.[/p][/*][/list][p] We also removed the total job ticket cap for a run, meaning you'll continue to receive new jobs even after completing the Super Job. The grind never ends, Boss. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215978/61d5387999b3e168f74f67b403b956891741f3ee.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔢Leaderboards[/h3][p]Leaderboards have been added to the game! At the end of a run, [b]your score will now be recorded across several boards.[/b] 

[b]Try to complete as many jobs and sell as many items as you can to boost your score[/b]; cash and faction reputation are both factored in, so go big or go home. As soon as you place Bobby on a level, the leaderboard for that level will appear on the right-hand billboard. [b]There are several leaderboard types[/b] to flex on different crowds: [/p][list][*][p][b]Time Filters[/b] → See how you fare compared to players who’ve played the level this week, this month, or since the founding of New Yolk.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Co-op or Single Player[/b] → Check who's topping the charts solo or with a partner in crime.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Friends Only[/b] → Compare scores with your pals and settle who's truly the most prolific contrabandist in your social circle.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]💵Synced Cash Register[/h3][p]As a first step to making co-op feel more fun and actually cooperative, we’ve synced the cash register between both players in multiplayer.
[/p][list][*][p][b]Storing money in the register adds to the other player’s total.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Removing money also affects both players[/b]. So if you’re broke, your buddy is too. Teamwork, baby. [/p][/*][/list][p][i]
Hide it right, and you'll sleep tight. 💤[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]New Content[/h1][p][b]We are releasing the new Premium drip this week with the Tacky Toucan[/b]. It is the first premium pack that showcases a new bird specie: the toucan and his kitch looks. 

We are also rotating the [b]free pack to a new dazed outfit, the "Baked & Bucket Pack"[/b]. Those red eyes are itching, but you got to keep crafting that booze and roll those cigarettes..[/p][h2] 
👕New Content[/h2][h3] 
🦜Tacky Toucan Pack (Premium)[/h3][p] This week, we’re releasing a brand-new premium drip with the [b]Tacky Toucan Pack![/b] It’s the first premium set to feature a [b]new bird species, the toucan, and his aggressively kitschy style[/b]. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215978/59666f83a011d026c3a8d92632c8fe38d1fa1812.png"][/img] Big beak, bigger fashion crimes. [/p][h3]
🔥Baked & Bucket Pack (Free)[/h3][p]
We're rotating the free cosmetic pack to something a little more... [b]glazed[/b]. Introducing the [b]Baked & Bucket Pack,[/b] a dazed new outfit featuring bleary [b]red eyes and a big ol’ bucket hat.[/b] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215978/d0f557f0403fd0f94eb88253251aeee64c64f743.png"][/img]Your character might look sleepy, but someone's gotta keep crafting that booze and rolling those cigarettes. [/p][h2] 
🛠️Minor Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Improved the [b]"Add Friends[/b]" pipeline with a UI change that now lets you [b]accept friend requests[/b] directly from the "[b]Add Friend" menu.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]We added a [b]colorful sign[/b] leading to the Customization Area in the Hideout because new players deserve a nudge toward all that juicy leverage spending.[/p][/*][*][p]While browsing the "[b]Spend Leverage[/b]" tab in the Customization menu, selecting a different faction now re-centers the UI alignment, making navigation feel more natural and comfy.[/p][/*][*][p]We made it easier to [b]hit the dough[/b] to craft pastries and to [b]hammer the barrel lid[/b] closed, based on feedback that it felt unnecessarily finicky. No more rage-baking.[/p][/*][/list][h2] [/h2][h2]🐞Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]players couldn’t use the arrow buttons in the “Spend Leverage” panel.[/b] Clicking on a faction now centers it for easier selection.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Partial fix for clients staying in the shop after a transaction.[/b] It should happen less often, more logging was added to help us track the cause. Please keep flagging the issue to us if it happens!,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that allowed players to duplicate money via the cash registers. [i]Naughty naughty.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced the force needed to punch dough and cookies[/b]. Closing the barrel should also feel easier now.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved diagnostic tools for better support when players share their UGS info alongside a bug report.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the chance of certain connection issues with Unity Gaming Services.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed screen printing paper facing the wrong way and getting stuck in the press.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed flickering on small wings[/b] for some bird skins.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]distiller lid couldn’t be placed in multiplayer.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed a money duplication exploit[/b] using the one-dollar bills and "Make It Rain".[/p][/*][/list][p]Various minor bugs have been fixed. [i](We won’t say who fixed them, but Bobby’s been suspiciously quiet.)[/i]
[/p][p][b][u]Don't forget to check out our Socials and have a chat with other Eggs![/u][/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/prisonboss" style="button"]Discord[/url] [url="https://x.com/Prison_Boss_" style="button"]Twitter[/url] [url="https://bsky.app/profile/trebuchetvr.bsky.social" style="button"]BlueSky[/url] [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@prisonboss_" style="button"]TikTok[/url] [url="https://www.instagram.com/trebuchetvr" style="button"]Instagram[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2973830/Prison_Boss_Prohibition/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Players can now choose between three different run lengths when starting a new game: 
Short (9 days)
Normal (12 days)
Ludicrous (30 days)… for the overachieving crime tycoon in you.
We also removed the total job ticket cap for a run, meaning you'll continue to receive new jobs even after completing the Super Job. The grind never ends, Boss.
Leaderboards have been added to the game! At the end of a run, your score will now be recorded across several boards.

Try to complete as many jobs and sell as many items as you can to boost your score; cash and faction reputation are both factored in, so go big or go home. As soon as you place Bobby on a level, the leaderboard for that level will appear on the right-hand billboard. There are several leaderboard types to flex on different crowds:
Time Filters → See how you fare compared to players who’ve played the level this week, this month, or since the founding of New Yolk.
Co-op or Single Player → Check who's topping the charts solo or with a partner in crime.
Friends Only → Compare scores with your pals and settle who's truly the most prolific contrabandist in your social circle.
As a first step to making co-op feel more fun and actually cooperative, we’ve synced the cash register between both players in multiplayer.
Storing money in the register adds to the other player’s total.
Removing money also affects both players. So if you’re broke, your buddy is too. Teamwork, baby.
We are releasing the new Premium drip this week with the Tacky Toucan. It is the first premium pack that showcases a new bird specie: the toucan and his kitch looks.
We are also rotating the free pack to a new dazed outfit, the "Baked & Bucket Pack". Those red eyes are itching, but you got to keep crafting that booze and roll those cigarettes..
This week, we’re releasing a brand-new premium drip with the Tacky Toucan Pack! It’s the first premium set to feature a new bird species, the toucan, and his aggressively kitschy style
We're rotating the free cosmetic pack to something a little more... glazed. Introducing the Baked & Bucket Pack, a dazed new outfit featuring bleary red eyes and a big ol’ bucket hat.
Improved the "Add Friends" pipeline with a UI change that now lets you accept friend requests directly from the "Add Friend" menu.
We added a colorful sign leading to the Customization Area in the Hideout because new players deserve a nudge toward all that juicy leverage spending.
While browsing the "Spend Leverage" tab in the Customization menu, selecting a different faction now re-centers the UI alignment, making navigation feel more natural and comfy.
We made it easier to hit the dough to craft pastries and to hammer the barrel lid closed, based on feedback that it felt unnecessarily finicky. No more rage-baking.

Fixed a bug that allowed players to duplicate money via the cash registers. Naughty naughty.

tags.balance_change: Reduced the force needed to punch dough and cookies. Closing the barrel should also feel easier now.

tags.bug: Improved diagnostic tools for better support when players share their UGS info alongside a bug report.
Reduced the chance of certain connection issues with Unity Gaming Services.
Fixed screen printing paper facing the wrong way and getting stuck in the press.
Fixed flickering on small wings for some bird skins.
Fixed a bug where the distiller lid couldn’t be placed in multiplayer.
Fixed a money duplication exploit using the one-dollar bills and "Make It Rain".

notes.title: Build 1.0.4 Release Notes
notes.content:
[p]Prison Boss Prohibition - Patch Notes 1.0.4 

[b]New[/b]:
   
- Added the content for unlocking the Mafioso pack and the first free pack starting July 24 at 9:00 PST. 

[b]Bug fixes[/b]:
 
- Fixed an issue with the still and other containers that could not accept more ingredients after some time. Please note that we are aware that other issues are present for the still and will work to fix those shortly.  
- Fixed a bug in multiplayer where the grinder became invisible if it was placed as a furniture by the other player.  
- Partial fix of an issue where the mold for the soap was overly sensitive to spilling liquids. 
The fix is not complete as a deeper refactor of our spilling mechanic needs to be worked on in order to have a better solution. We felt that providing a quick partial fix was better than nothing.  
- Fixed various issues in the backend relating to cloud authentication of the users and when sending player data to the servers. Please note we still see some problems that need to be addressed here and we are working on it.  
- Fixed a rendering issue where the neck of the chicken avatars was Z-fighting with the clothes.  
Improved the cosmetic sets video loops and some issues regarding UI icons in the customization area of the Hideout.  
- Fixed some various exceptions that could happen in different scenario without impacting the user experience in order to help us narrow down the cause of the larger issues. [/p]

notes.title: Build 1.0.3 Release Notes
notes.content:

Left controller pad click now opens the menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Conversation Control:[/b]
Right controller pad click advances conversations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hint Layer Usage:[/b]

notes.title: Build 1.0.2 Release Notes
notes.content:
This update brings several bug fixes to the game!
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where, when playing in co-op, buying items from the supplier resetted the other player's order.
[*] Fixed an issue where, if co-op players completed a beer started by the other player, it would be stuck at the fermenting phase.
[*] Fixed an issue where the phone orders would sometime not generate a ticket in the expected time.
[*] Fixed a UI issue in the Hideout where adding a friend showed his name as "Player 01" instead of the proper username.
[*] Fixed an issue where the jobs in the Docks level were asking for Sodas too often compared to Beers.
[*] Fixed an issue where the equipped items appeared floating in the Hideout in some occasions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the fade to black wouldn't trigger properly when putting your head in the shop's wall.
[*] Fixed some text overlaps in the books when using other languages than English.
[*] Improved the behavior and tracking of the pre-order neck equipable.
[*] Fixed an issue where very small objects that could be thrown out of the shop would not respawn properly.
[/list]

notes.title: Free Alpha Weekends on Quest & Launch Delay
notes.content:
Hey fyolks! 🐔

[b]We’ve got a few important updates to share with you all[/b] — some exciting, some that require a bit of patience, but all part of the omelette AU fromage we’re cooking together.

[h3]👤 New Chief of Staff Appointed[/h3]
Please join us in giving a warm welcome to [b]our new Community Manager Ozan (schenkal on Discord)[/b], aka the Mayor’s right hand! 

They’ll be your go-to for all things community, events, and mischief. [b]Expect more activity, more transparency, and more F U N around here very soon.[/b]

[h3]🕒 Game Launch Delayed to Summer 2025[/h3]
Now, for the bad news. We know waiting is the hardest part — and we’re just as eager to get you fully immersed in illegal crafting shenanigans. 

To make sure everything hits the quality bar you deserve,[b] we’ve made the hard decision to shift our release to Summer 2025[/b]. It’s a tough call, a bad egg some might even say, but the right one. [b]We appreciate your love and support[/b] and can’t wait to show you what we’re cooking up.

[h3]🗺️ Alpha Roadmap Reveal[/h3]
BUT, we have some good news as well! [b]You won’t have to wait until Summer to play.[/b] Starting soon, we’re kicking off our [b]Free Alpha Playtest Weekends![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215978/25db933cd7d72d2ae9ef796c33467d0872bb2793.png[/img]

[u][b]Here’s how it’ll work:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Every 2 weeks, a new level will unlock and be [b]available to play all weekend long.[/b]
[*] Levels will rotate, giving everyone a chance to explore different environments and crafting themes. 
[*] It's currently only available on Quest, but we're doing our best to have a Steam version too before the end of the Alpha weekends.[/list]
This is your chance to help shape the game while having a blast. [b]We’ll be listening closely to your feedback every step of the way[/b] so please, feel free to share your thoughts!

[url=https://discord.gg/prisonboss][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45215978/b749068f711b16929e0a72a381a974ac1c74effc.png[/img][/url]
As always, [url=https://discord.gg/prisonboss][b]JOIN US ON DISCORD[/b][/url], hit us up in the channels with your thoughts, questions, or wild theories. We love hearing from our favorite chickens. 🐔

[b]See you in New Yolk City, The Prison Boss team[/b]

[u][b]Don't forget to check out our Socials and have a chat with other Eggs![/b][/u]
